params.body:
## Why

The desk's morning mail went to an address list in the `.env`. Nobody at the desk can see or change that list, and it does not follow the team: someone who leaves keeps getting the mail until somebody edits a file on the server.

## What

- `users.desk_mail`, off by default. `PATCH /auth/users/:id` with `{deskMail: true|false}` sets it; admin only. It is the one thing an admin may also set on their own account, since it locks nobody out. A role in the same request on yourself is still refused.
- `deskMailRecipients()`: people on the team with the setting on, not removed, whose account was not deleted and who accepted their invitation.
- `runDeskMail` reads its recipients there. `DESK_EMAILS` is gone. With nobody switched on it skips with "nobody gets the morning mail".
- `GET /auth/users` carries `desk_mail`, for the Accounts page.

The mailer's key and the sender address stay in the environment: they are secrets of the server, not settings of the desk.

## Checked

- `test/team-management.test.mjs`: nobody until switched on; a non-admin is refused; an admin on themselves; refused for someone removed; leaving the team and an open invitation stop the mail; switching off.
- `test/desk-open.test.mjs`: the mail's own cases run against the setting.
- Full suite 1770/1770, `tsc` clean. No real mail was sent.

## After merge

The column is added at start. The control is in the dashboard pull request of the same name; until someone is switched on there, no mail goes out.
params.title: Who gets the morning mail is set per account, not in the environment
